app_fee.value: UZH charges CHF 100 for doctoral applications; it is non-refundable.
app_fee.quote: Bachelor's and Master's Degree, Teaching Diploma and Doctoral Studies 100.— | Application fees will not be refunded or credited against other fees.

fee_waiver.value: No fee waiver is described on the UZH fee page.

gre_general.value: UZH sets no GRE rule; the doctoral program or graduate school decides.

toefl_min.value: Set per program: UZH leaves the doctoral English check to the department or graduate school.
toefl_min.quote: The language skills required for matriculation at the doctoral level are assessed during the admissions process by the institute/department or the graduate school

notes: Doctoral admission starts with the faculty, graduate school or supervisor, then a separate UZH Admissions Office application. Non-EU/EFTA citizens need a visa; UZH generally applies on your behalf.
